evidence: Bazecor's hardware-virtual keyboards (src/api/hardware-virtual), cross-checked at record time against the shipped default backups (src/defaultBackups) — the two sources agree token for token on every recorded config command. The shipped Defy WIRED backup is the known outlier: its keymap.custom differs from the virtual keyboards and the wireless backup at wire positions 72-73 of layer 0 (right thumb-cluster keys: 0 0 vs 54109 54108, the bluetooth-pairing and battery-status keys). Settings exist only in the virtual keyboards — backups capture no settings — so their evidence class is Bazecor's simulation alone.
